title: IntegralModelsTensorClosure
statement: For a finite subextension E of the l-adic algebraic closure and a Noetherian scheme X, the ambient uncompleted relative derived tensor of two bounded complexes with finite constant scalar constructible cohomology again has bounded finite constant scalar constructible cohomology. Here constructibility and bounded constructibility mean [sk-def-sfb-constructible, sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible], and the tensor is [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom].

source.place: parent proof step 8, using the separate degree-zero calculation

proof.text: Let P be the object property of sheaves having finite constant scalar constructible models. Transport models along isomorphisms. The zero sheaf has the zero finite presentation on every stratum. The integral weak Serre theorem gives closure of P under kernels, cokernels and extensions. The homology-property API then makes Q = bounded intersect homologyProperty P a triangulated, isomorphism-closed property.

The degree-zero sheaf tensor calculation supplies Q(F[0] tensor G[0]) for every pair F,G satisfying P. Fix G. Derived tensor by G[0] is triangulated, with its canonical shift comparison. Apply the existing DerivedCategory.prop_of_bounded to the inverse image of Q under this functor: all single sheaves satisfy the property, so every bounded K with P-cohomology does. Fix K and apply the same theorem in the second variable to M. This proves Q(K tensor M). This is precisely two finite truncation inductions, including the zero and single-degree cases; no local splitting of arbitrary complexes is used. In Lean carry out the two inductions and the weak Serre transport in a private lemma for an arbitrary abelian monoidal category, then specialize it to the coefficient module category using the integral heart-closure and sheaf-tensor theorems. Transport the sheaf case and the conclusion along the explicit equality between the coefficient derivedTensor and curriedTensor; this is equality transport, with no change of tensor structure.

theorem integralModels_tensor_closure (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ) (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (K M : DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) X)))
    (hK : constantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) X K)
    (hM : constantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) X M) :
    constantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) X
      (((derivedTensor (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) X).obj K).obj M)
